# Spotify Q2'26: Stark leverans igen

**Feed**: inderes-se  
**Published**: 2026-08-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Episode covers Spotify's Q2'26 report, framed as an in-house analyst interview. The report was broadly in line with or slightly above expectations, delivering on gross margin (record 33.4%), subscribers and EBIT, though MAU growth and Q3 margin guidance came in softer than expected. The analyst reiterates a BUY with a $570 target, viewing weaker MAU as a deliberate shift toward monetization and higher-quality paying users, and rising costs as temporary/variable rather than structural.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SPOT — Spotify | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Solid Q2 delivering on gross margin, subscribers, EBIT; record 33.4% gross margin; softer MAU is deliberate monetization choice; costs seen as non-structural/variable. Reiterated buy, $570 target.

#### Reasoning

Analyst reiterates buy with unchanged $570 target after Q2. Thesis: continued double-digit growth driven by monetization and price increases, margin expansion from mix-shift to podcasts/audiobooks and add-ons (e.g. AI remixes). MAU miss is a deliberate self-inflicted choice to prioritize paying, higher-quality users; cost increases are mostly variable (AI compute, marketing) with flat headcount and temporary, not structural. Strong balance sheet; valuation at low end of acceptable range, good en

#### Sell Triggers

- if MAU growth AND subscriber growth both decline (no longer a deliberate choice)
- if Q4 costs do not moderate or margins fail to expand year-on-year
- if gross margin declines
- if ARPU/subscriber monetization fails to improve

> *"Vi säger köp på Spotify efter deras Q2-rapport förra veckan som mer eller mindre var enligt förväntan kanske till och med lite bättre."*
